def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames = []
    border_cells = set()
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if len(cells) < 8:
            continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        perim = ({(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)} | {(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)} |
                 {(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1)} | {(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)})
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r,c in perim):
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,perim)); border_cells |= perim
    counts={}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v and (r,c) not in border_cells:
                counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,perim in frames:
        for r,c in perim: out[r][c]=color
        candidates=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if (r-r0-1+c-c0-1)%2==0]
        # A marker color's number of loose pixels is the number of alternating cells to paint.
        marker=next((v for v,n in counts.items() if n==len(candidates)),None)
        if marker is None:
            marker=next((v for v,n in counts.items() if 0<n<len(candidates)),None)
        if marker is not None:
            for r,c in candidates[:counts[marker]]: out[r][c]=marker
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames = []
    frame_border = set()
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if len(cells) < 8:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        border = ({(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)} | {(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)} |
                  {(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1)} | {(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)})
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r,c in border):
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,border))
            frame_border |= border
    counts = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v and (r,c) not in frame_border:
                counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,border in frames:
        for r,c in border:
            out[r][c] = color
        pattern = [(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)
                   if (r-r0-1+c-c0-1) % 2 == 0]
        marker = next((v for v,n in counts.items() if n == len(pattern)), None)
        if marker is not None:
            for r,c in pattern:
                out[r][c] = marker
    return out
